core.headline: 2-bedroom mid-terrace, Station Terrace, Sheerness
core.summary: For sale by Modern Method of Auction. A 2-bedroom mid-terrace house on Station Terrace in Sheerness, offered with no onward chain and requiring modernisation throughout. Freehold. Guide Price £150,000.
core.listing:
For sale by Modern Method of Auction. A 2-bedroom mid-terrace house on Station Terrace in Sheerness, offered with no onward chain and requiring modernisation throughout. The property has gas central heating and a rear yard.

The ground floor provides a reception room, kitchen and bathroom. On the first floor are two bedrooms.

Outside is a rear yard. On-street parking is available with no permit required.

Guide Price £150,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band A (Swale Borough Council). EPC rating E. Modern Method of Auction: the buyer pays a non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000) including VAT, in addition to the purchase price; 56-day reservation period. The guide price indicates the seller's minimum expectation; the reserve will be within 10% of the guide.
keyFeatures: For sale by Modern Method of Auction
